1	# Third-party skills vendored into this repository
2	
3	Installed by manual copy from pinned commits after a read-only source review. No plugin, hook, marketplace entry, or `npx skills add` was used. Security review reports: `plans/reports/superpowers-skills-security-review.md`, `plans/reports/vercel-agent-skills-security-review.md`.
4	
5	To re-verify or update, diff a folder against the upstream commit listed below. Local edits are the only expected differences.
6	
7	## Superpowers — https://github.com/obra/superpowers
8	
9	License: MIT. Commit `2ce8aa15d05bd57213e6f746f953aafb7ded7a8b` (2026-10-21, v7.0.1).
10	
11	| Folder | Local edits |
12	|---|---|
13	| `test-driven-development/` | `writing-good-tests.md`: one `superpowers:writing-skills` cross-reference reworded (that skill is not installed). |
14	| `verification-before-completion/` | none |
15	| `systematic-debugging/` | Removed 2026-11-04, replaced by the local `debug` skill. Its `root-cause-tracing.md`, `defense-in-depth.md`, `condition-based-waiting.md`, `condition-based-waiting-example.ts` and `find-polluter.sh` were moved unchanged into `debug/`; `SKILL.md`, `CREATION-LOG.md` and the `test-*.md` pressure scenarios were deleted. `find-polluter.sh` iterates test files and runs `npm test <file>`; run it only deliberately. |
16	| `brainstorming/` | Prose only: `scripts/` (local Node server with a browser telemetry beacon to primeradiant.com) and `visual-companion.md` were NOT copied, and the "Visual Companion" section plus its two offer paragraphs were removed from `SKILL.md`. Description reworded from "You MUST use this before any creative work" to a scoped trigger. Design doc location changed from `docs/superpowers/specs/…, committed` to `plans/<YYMMDD-HHMM>-<topic>/design.md`, not committed. Handoff now names the local `writing-plans` skill. |
17	| `writing-plans/` | Plan location changed from `docs/superpowers/plans/<date>-<name>.md` to this repo's `plans/<YYMMDD-HHMM>-<name>/` folder convention. "Frequent commits" and the worktree note removed. The required-sub-skill header line and the whole "Execution Handoff" section (subagent-driven-development / executing-plans) replaced with: ask for explicit approval, then implement in-session per `.claude/rules/primary-workflow.md`. |
18	
19	Deliberately not installed: `using-superpowers` and the SessionStart hook (injects a mandatory-skill preamble that conflicts with `.claude/rules`), `executing-plans` and `subagent-driven-development` ("do not pause to check in" posture), `diagnosing-superpowers` (reads session transcripts, creates GitHub issues), `requesting-code-review` and `receiving-code-review` (covered by the existing code-reviewer agent), `writing-skills`, `using-git-worktrees`, `finishing-a-development-branch`, `dispatching-parallel-agents`.
20	
21	Overlap note: the parent folder `../../../.claude` already provides `brainstorm`, `planning` and `multi-agent-brainstorming` skills and `brainstormer` and `planner` agents. The two Superpowers skills above are the Socratic question-first variants and coexist with them; prefer one style per task rather than chaining both.

24	
25	License: MIT. Commit `4ae2317ddb22b046e26455e4f9c9b3aaaf62212d` (2026-10-31), `skills/engineering/`. Read as reference only: nothing was copied verbatim, no script was run, no plugin or `npx skills add` was used.

Added: Acme evidence sources, an owner-approval gate before fixing. `scripts/hitl-loop.template.sh` not copied. |

Added: codebase-first exploration, approach comparison, fixed 7-section output, `[Verified]`/`[Assumption]` tags. Runs inline instead of as a background agent so requirement questions can be asked. |

content.text:
Tasks 7.1–7.7 are all done, and `pnpm nx run-many -t build lint test -p web` exits 0. I touched nothing outside `apps/web`, made no commits and left `tasks.md` unticked.

## Per task

| Task | Status | Verifying spec (under `/workspace/spec-duel/openspec-variant/apps/web/src/`) |
|---|---|---|
| 7.1 | done | `services/booking.service.spec.ts` |
| 7.2 | done | `views/bookings/booking-time-format.spec.ts` |
| 7.3 | done | `views/bookings/bookings-table.spec.tsx`, `views/bookings/booking-room-filter.spec.tsx` |
| 7.4 | done | `views/bookings/booking-create-form.spec.tsx` |
| 7.5 | done | `views/bookings/booking-edit-dialog.spec.tsx`, `views/bookings/booking-delete-dialog.spec.tsx` |
| 7.6 | done | `views/bookings/bookings-page.spec.tsx` and `views/bookings/bookings-page-actions.spec.tsx` |
| 7.7 | done | `layouts/app-layout.spec.tsx` |

Each spec was run and seen failing before its implementation was written, and every case named in the tasks' verify clauses is covered.

## Final command output

- **test:** 14 suites passed, 65 tests passed, 0 failed, with no React or MUI console warnings.
- **lint:** "All files pass linting".
- **build:** compiled successfully; `/bookings` is prerendered as static content (19.7 kB) next to `/rooms`.
- **`uuid` under jsdom:** the real `v4` loads and runs under jsdom, so the key generator is not mocked; the specs assert real UUIDs.

## Contradictions with the design or specs

- **Delete error location.** Task 7.5 lists "the API message shown" for both dialogs, but D9 puts delete errors in an `Alert` on the page. I followed D9: the delete dialog only confirms or declines, and the page calls `deleteBooking` and shows the error. The edit dialog shows its own API message.
- **Page spec split.** Task 7.6 names one `bookings-page.spec.tsx`; I split it in two to stay under 200 lines. The create, edit and delete cases are in `bookings-page-actions.spec.tsx`.
- **Extra file.** `views/bookings/booking-test-data.ts` (shared test fixtures) is not in the D9 file list.
- **Extra export.** `booking-time-format.ts` also exports `isEndAfterStart`, shared by the create form and the edit dialog.

## Assumptions

- **Service signatures:** `listBookings(page, limit, roomId?)`, `updateBooking(id, changes)`, `deleteBooking(id)`. D9 only fixes `createBooking(booking, idempotencyKey)`.
- **Actions column:** the table has a seventh "Actions" column for the buttons, which are labelled "Edit <title>" and "Delete <title>".
- **Native selects:** the room filter and the form's room field are native selects inside MUI `TextField`. The filter is labelled "Filter by room" and the form field "Room".
- **Fixed page size:** the bookings table always uses 10 rows per page, with no rows-per-page selector.
- **Client validation:** only required fields and end-after-start are checked, as the spec states. Email format is left to the API, and the title input is capped at `BOOKING_TITLE_MAX_LENGTH`.
- **Rooms load failure:** treated as a load error (alert, no table), with its own spec case.
- **Delete of the last row on a later page:** the page steps back one page instead of showing an empty one. This is not in the spec and has a spec case.
- **Wording I chose:** "New booking", "Create booking", "Edit booking", "Delete booking?", "<Field> is required" and "End must be later than start".

## Left open

Task 8.5 (the page against the running gateway) is not verified, since the backend was not available.

## Report: backend half of `add-room-bookings` (task groups 1–6)

All of 1.1–6.4 are implemented and unit-tested, except that the migration (1.3) has not been run against a database, as instructed. Nothing was exercised against Postgres, Redis or NATS, so the TypeORM runtime behaviour and the concurrency guarantee still need your group 8 checks.

### Final command
`pnpm nx run-many -t build lint test -p backend-common booking gateway worker` ended with "Successfully ran targets build, lint, test for 4 projects and 1 task they depend on".

| Project | Suites | Tests | Build | Lint |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| backend-common | 4 passed | 24 passed | ok | ok |
| booking | 12 passed | 81 passed | ok | ok |
| gateway | 6 passed | 50 passed | ok | ok |
| worker | 5 passed | 39 passed | ok | ok |

No failures and no skipped tests.

### Per task
Paths are relative to `/workspace/spec-duel/openspec-variant`.

| Task | Status | Verifying spec |
|---|---|---|
| 1.1 | done | `libs/backend-common/src/lib/errors/error-response.guard.spec.ts` (existing filter spec unchanged, still passes) |
| 1.2 | done | `nx build backend-common` |
| 1.3 | written and registered, **not run against the DB** | `nx build backend-common` only |
| 2.1 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/booking-time.util.spec.ts`, `booking.mapper.spec.ts` |
| 2.2 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/booking.repository.spec.ts` |
| 2.3 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/booking.validator.spec.ts` |
| 2.4 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/booking.service.spec.ts` |
| 2.5 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/booking.controller.spec.ts` |
| 3.1 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/booking-fingerprint.util.spec.ts` |
| 3.2 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/room-lookup.client.spec.ts` |
| 3.3 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/confirmation-queue.producer.spec.ts` |
| 3.4 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/idempotent-booking.repository.spec.ts` |
| 3.5 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/booking.service.create.spec.ts` (split from the service spec for the 200-line limit), `booking.controller.spec.ts` |
| 4.1 | done | `apps/booking/src/booking/booking.repository.spec.ts` |
| 4.2 | done | `booking.service.spec.ts`, `booking.controller.spec.ts` |
| 5.1 | done | `apps/gateway/src/booking/idempotency-key.guard.spec.ts` |
| 5.2 | done | `apps/gateway/src/booking/idempotency-replayed.interceptor.spec.ts` |
| 5.3 | done | `apps/gateway/src/booking/booking.controller.spec.ts` |
| 6.1 | done | `apps/worker/src/confirmation/simulated-confirmation.sender.spec.ts` |
| 6.2 | done | `apps/worker/src/confirmation/booking.client.spec.ts` |
| 6.3 | done | `apps/worker/src/confirmation/confirmation.service.spec.ts` |
| 6.4 | done | `apps/worker/src/confirmation/confirmation.processor.spec.ts` |

### Where I went beyond or against the design
- **Boolean replies for delete and record-confirmation.** The design does not say what `BookingPatternEnum.DELETE` and `RECORD_CONFIRMATION` reply. A handler that replies nothing would make `NatsRequestUtil.send` reject on the caller side (read from the `@nestjs/microservices` source, not reproduced), which would turn every delete into a 500 and every confirmation report into a retry. Both handlers therefore reply a boolean; the gateway still answers 204 with an empty body (covered by its spec).
- **Jest config edits.** I added `setupFiles: ['reflect-metadata']` to `jest.config.ts` in `apps/booking`, `apps/gateway` and `apps/worker`. Specs whose first runtime import is `@roombook/contract` otherwise fail with "Reflect.getMetadata is not a function".
- **Test helper outside D1.** `apps/booking/src/booking/testing/booking.fixture.ts` is a shared fixture. It is not a `*.spec.ts`, so `tsconfig.app.json` type-checks it, but it is not bundled.
- **Transaction style.** I used `DataSource.transaction` as your task and D4 say; the backend convention I normally follow asks for an explicit QueryRunner. Say if you want it switched.
- **Guard and interceptor as providers.** Both are listed as providers in the gateway `BookingModule`, in addition to `@UseGuards` / `@UseInterceptors` on the create handler.

### Assumptions
- **Update writes merged values.** `updateBooking` always writes the merged `title`, `startsAt` and `endsAt`, as D6 describes, including for `{}`.
- **`updatedAt` moves.** Because `updated_at` is an `UpdateDateColumn`, I expect it to change on an empty PATCH and when a confirmation outcome is recorded. The spec's "stored values" for an empty body is ambiguous on this.
- **Job name.** The contract has none, so the job name is `QueueEnum.BOOKING_CONFIRMATION`.
- **Date-only times.** A value such as `2030-01-01` passes the contract's `IsISO8601` and is read as midnight UTC.

- **Idempotency key case.** The key is forwarded as sent. Postgres treats `ABC…` and `abc…` as the same uuid, but the advisory lock hashes the text. Lower-casing the key in the service would close it.

- **Replay header in the browser.** `apps/gateway/src/main.ts` enables CORS without exposed headers, so browser code cannot read `Idempotency-Replayed`. The web spec does not appear to need it.

`git status` also shows changes under `apps/web`; those belong to the other agent. I did not touch `libs/contract`, `apps/room`, `openspec/`, `package.json` or lockfiles, added no dependency, and made no commits.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Starts infra, runs migrations, builds and starts every app. Exits 0 once the gateway answers.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

[ -f .env ] || scripts/make-local-env.sh
set -a
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
. ./.env
set +a

mkdir -p tmp/logs tmp/pids

docker compose up -d --wait
pnpm run migration:run
pnpm run build

export NODE_ENV=production

start_app() {
  local name="$1"
  shift
  "$@" > "tmp/logs/${name}.log" 2>&1 &
  echo $! > "tmp/pids/${name}.pid"
}

for app in room booking worker gateway; do
  start_app "$app" node "dist/apps/${app}/main.js"
done
start_app web pnpm nx serve web --prod --port "${WEB_PORT}"

health_url="http://localhost:${GATEWAY_PORT}/api/health/gateway"
for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -fs -o /dev/null "$health_url"; then
    echo "Stack is up: gateway on ${GATEWAY_PORT}, web on ${WEB_PORT}." >&2
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 1
done

echo "Gateway did not answer at ${health_url}; see tmp/logs/." >&2
exit 1
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stops the apps started by stack-up.sh and the compose services. Pass --volumes to drop the data.
set -uo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

if [ -d tmp/pids ]; then
  for pid_file in tmp/pids/*.pid; do
    [ -e "$pid_file" ] || continue
    pid="$(cat "$pid_file")"
    kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -f "$pid_file"
  done
fi

if [ -f .env ]; then
  if [ "${1:-}" = "--volumes" ]; then
    docker compose down --volumes
  else
    docker compose down
  fi
fi

# Tasks

Conventions for every task: write the failing spec first, then the code; follow `design.md` for file names and the project rules for style (no `interface`, no `any`, named DTO classes for parameters, explicit repository return types, files under 200 lines). Do not touch `libs/contract`, `apps/room` or `apps/web/src/views/rooms`.

## 1. Shared library (`libs/backend-common`)

- [ ] 1.1 Move `isErrorResponse` from `errors/rpc-exception.filter.ts` into an exported `errors/error-response.guard.ts` with its own spec (object with the three fields, missing field, non-object), import it in the filter and export it from `index.ts`; verify `pnpm nx test backend-common` passes with the existing filter spec unchanged
- [ ] 1.2 Add `entities/booking.entity.ts` and `entities/idempotency-key.entity.ts` with the columns of design D3, export both from `index.ts` and add them to the `entities` list in `database/data-source.ts`; verify `pnpm nx build backend-common` passes
- [ ] 1.3 Add `database/migrations/1731200000002-create-bookings.ts` creating `bookings` (both `CHECK` constraints, both indexes) and `idempotency_keys`, with a `down` that drops them, and register it in `migrations/index.ts`; verify `pnpm run migration:run` then `pnpm run migration:revert` then `pnpm run migration:run` all succeed against the local stack database

## 2. Booking service: read, list, update, delete (`apps/booking`)

- [ ] 2.1 Add `booking-time.util.ts` (zone-less value read as UTC, unparseable value raises 400 `BAD_REQUEST.VALIDATION`) and `booking.mapper.ts` (entity to `BookingDto`, times through `toISOString()`); verify their specs cover an offset, a zone-less value, a week date and the mapped field list
- [ ] 2.2 Add `booking.repository.ts` with `findById`, `findPage` (order `starts_at, id`, `skip = (page - 1) * limit`, optional `roomId`), `update` and `delete`, each with an explicit return type; verify `booking.repository.spec.ts` asserts the query options for page 1, page 2 with limit 5, the room filter, and `null` / `false` for an unknown id
- [ ] 2.3 Add `booking.validator.ts` with the time-order rule (equal and earlier both rejected with 400 `BAD_REQUEST.VALIDATION`); verify its spec covers later, equal and earlier
- [ ] 2.4 Add `booking.service.ts` with `listBookings`, `findBookingById`, `updateBooking` (read, merge stored and changed values, validate, update) and `deleteBooking`, raising 404 `NOT_FOUND.BOOKING` through `ExceptionHelper`; verify `booking.service.spec.ts` covers the found and not-found path of each method, an update that moves `startsAt` past the stored `endsAt`, and an empty change set
- [ ] 2.5 Add `booking.controller.ts` handlers for `BookingPatternEnum.LIST`, `FIND_BY_ID`, `UPDATE` and `DELETE` (one delegating statement each) and `booking.module.ts`; register the module and `NatsClientModule` in the app module; verify the controller spec asserts each pattern's metadata and delegation, and `pnpm nx build booking` passes

## 3. Booking service: idempotent create and confirmation job (`apps/booking`)

- [ ] 3.1 Add `booking-fingerprint.util.ts` (SHA-256 hex over the five fields as sent, fixed order); verify its spec shows equal bodies give equal fingerprints, and a changed title or a differently written instant gives a different one
- [ ] 3.2 Add `room-lookup.client.ts` asking `RoomPatternEnum.FIND_BY_ID` through `NatsRequestUtil`, re-raising `NOT_FOUND.ROOM` as a 404 `RpcException` and letting `UNAVAILABLE.SERVICE` pass; verify its spec covers found, unknown room and no answer
- [ ] 3.3 Add `confirmation-queue.producer.ts` and register the queue `QueueEnum.BOOKING_CONFIRMATION` in the booking module; verify its spec asserts `add` is called with payload `{ bookingId }`, `jobId` `confirmationJobId(bookingId)`, `attempts` 3 and exponential backoff with delay 1000, and that a rejected `add` is logged and not rethrown
- [ ] 3.4 Add `idempotent-booking.repository.ts` with `findByKey` and the single-transaction `create` of design D4 (try advisory lock, read key, insert booking, insert key row), returning the named outcome type; verify its spec, with a mocked `DataSource.transaction` and entity manager, covers the three outcomes and asserts nothing is inserted for *in progress* and *existing*
- [ ] 3.5 Add `createBooking` to the service in the order of design D4 (validate, fast-path key read, room lookup, repository create, enqueue only for *created*) and the `BookingPatternEnum.CREATE` handler; verify `booking.service.spec.ts` covers: created (enqueued once, `replayed` false), replay from the fast path and from the repository (`replayed` true, stored body, no room lookup on the fast path, no enqueue), different fingerprint → 422 `UNPROCESSABLE.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, in progress → 409 `CONFLICT.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS`, invalid time order → 400 before any key read, unknown room → 404 with nothing stored

## 4. Booking service: record confirmation (`apps/booking`)

- [ ] 4.1 Add `recordConfirmation` to `booking.repository.ts` as one conditional update (`confirmation_status = 'PENDING'` and `confirmation_attempts <= :attempts`); verify the repository spec asserts the where-clause and that zero affected rows resolves without error
- [ ] 4.2 Add `recordConfirmationResult` to the service and the `BookingPatternEnum.RECORD_CONFIRMATION` handler; verify the service and controller specs cover a recorded outcome and an unknown booking id answered without error

## 5. Gateway (`apps/gateway`)

- [ ] 5.1 Add `idempotency-key.guard.ts`; verify its spec covers a missing header, a non-UUID value (both 400 `BAD_REQUEST.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`) and a valid UUID
- [ ] 5.2 Add `idempotency-replayed.interceptor.ts`; verify its spec shows the body becomes the booking, and the `Idempotency-Replayed: true` header is set only when `replayed` is true
- [ ] 5.3 Add `booking.controller.ts` with the five routes of the `bookings-api` spec and `booking.module.ts`, registered in the app module; verify `booking.controller.spec.ts` (HTTP listener with a mocked NATS client, as in `room.controller.spec.ts`) covers: 201 forwarding `{ idempotencyKey, booking }` to `BookingPatternEnum.CREATE`; replay header; missing key → 400 `BAD_REQUEST.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY` without a NATS call, also when the body is invalid; invalid body → 400 `BAD_REQUEST.VALIDATION`; list defaults, room filter and each invalid query; `GET`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` forwarding with their payload classes; `DELETE` → 204 with an empty body; non-UUID `:id` → 400; an error object from the booking service answered with its status and `errorCode`

## 6. Worker (`apps/worker`)

- [ ] 6.1 Add `simulated-confirmation.sender.ts`; verify its spec is a table over attempts 1 to 3 for an ordinary address, `@retry.example`, `@bounce.example` and an upper-case domain
- [ ] 6.2 Add `booking.client.ts` (find the booking, returning `null` for `NOT_FOUND.BOOKING`; report an outcome) over `NatsRequestUtil`; verify its spec covers found, not found, another error rethrown, and the reported payload
- [ ] 6.3 Add `confirmation.service.ts` implementing the run of design D7; verify its spec covers: ordinary address → reports `SENT`/1 and resolves; retry address attempts 1 and 2 → reports `PENDING` with the attempt and rejects, attempt 3 → `SENT`/3; bounce address attempt 3 → reports `FAILED`/3 and rejects; booking not found → no send, no report, resolves; booking already `SENT` → no send, no report; the same attempt run twice → identical report
- [ ] 6.4 Add `confirmation.processor.ts` on `QueueEnum.BOOKING_CONFIRMATION` (delegates with `bookingId` and `attemptsMade + 1`) and `confirmation.module.ts`; register it and `NatsClientModule` in the app module; verify the processor spec asserts the delegation and `pnpm nx build worker` passes

## 7. Web: services, page and navigation (`apps/web`)

- [ ] 7.1 Add `services/booking.service.ts` (`listBookings`, `createBooking`, `updateBooking`, `deleteBooking`); verify `booking.service.spec.ts`, with `apiClient` mocked, asserts each path and method, that `roomId` is left out when not given, and that create sends the `Idempotency-Key` header
- [ ] 7.2 Add `views/bookings/booking-time-format.ts`; verify its spec covers ISO → `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`, ISO → input value and input value → ISO UTC
- [ ] 7.3 Add `bookings-table.tsx` and `booking-room-filter.tsx`; verify their specs cover the six columns, room name with fallback to the room id, the empty message, the edit and delete actions calling back with the row's booking, and the filter options with "All rooms"
- [ ] 7.4 Add `booking-create-form.tsx` using `react-hook-form` without a resolver; verify its spec covers a valid submit (payload in ISO UTC), a required-field error, the end-after-start error, the disabled button while pending, the API message shown with values kept, the same key reused after a network error, a new key after success and a new key after a field change
- [ ] 7.5 Add `booking-edit-dialog.tsx` and `booking-delete-dialog.tsx`; verify their specs cover prefilled values, save, cancel, the end-after-start error, confirm, decline and the API message shown
- [ ] 7.6 Add `bookings-page.tsx` and `pages/bookings/index.tsx`; verify `bookings-page.spec.tsx`, with `booking.service` and `room.service` mocked, covers loading, rows, empty, load error with the API message, filtering by room (page reset to 1), paging, reload after create, edit and delete, and a delete error
- [ ] 7.7 Add the "Bookings" item to `NAV_ITEMS` in `layouts/app-layout.tsx`; verify `app-layout.spec.tsx` asserts both the "Rooms" and the "Bookings" links

## 8. Integration checks

- [ ] 8.1 Run `pnpm run build`, `pnpm run lint` and `pnpm run test`; verify all three exit 0, and that `git status` shows no change under `libs/contract`, `apps/room` or `apps/web/src/views/rooms`
- [ ] 8.2 Start the stack with `pnpm run stack:up` and walk the `bookings-api` scenarios through the gateway with `curl`; verify create 201, list with and without `roomId`, read, patch, delete 204 then 404, unknown room 404 `NOT_FOUND.ROOM`, and `endsAt` not after `startsAt` 400
- [ ] 8.3 Against the running stack, verify the `booking-idempotency` scenarios: missing and malformed key 400; replay answers the same body with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; a different body answers 422; ten parallel identical requests leave exactly one booking, with every answer being the one plain 201, a replayed 201 or a 409; a key used for a rejected request works afterwards
- [ ] 8.4 Against the running stack, verify the `booking-confirmation` scenarios by reading each booking after its job finished: an ordinary address ends `SENT` with 1 attempt, `@retry.example` ends `SENT` with 3, `@bounce.example` ends `FAILED` with 3, and a booking deleted right after creation leaves no failed job in `tmp/logs/worker.log`
- [ ] 8.5 Open `/bookings` in the web app; verify the navigation link, the table, the room filter, create, edit and delete work against the gateway, then stop the stack with `pnpm run stack:down`

Conventions for every task: write the failing spec first, then the code; follow `design.md` for file names and the project rules for style (no `interface`, no `any`, named DTO classes for parameters, explicit repository return types, files under 200 lines). Do not touch `libs/contract`, `apps/room` or `apps/web/src/views/rooms`.

## 1. Shared library (`libs/backend-common`)

- [x] 1.1 Move `isErrorResponse` from `errors/rpc-exception.filter.ts` into an exported `errors/error-response.guard.ts` with its own spec (object with the three fields, missing field, non-object), import it in the filter and export it from `index.ts`; verify `pnpm nx test backend-common` passes with the existing filter spec unchanged
- [ ] 1.2 Add `entities/booking.entity.ts` and `entities/idempotency-key.entity.ts` with the columns of design D3, export both from `index.ts` and add them to the `entities` list in `database/data-source.ts`; verify `pnpm nx build backend-common` passes
- [ ] 1.3 Add `database/migrations/1731200000002-create-bookings.ts` creating `bookings` (both `CHECK` constraints, both indexes) and `idempotency_keys`, with a `down` that drops them, and register it in `migrations/index.ts`; verify `pnpm run migration:run` then `pnpm run migration:revert` then `pnpm run migration:run` all succeed against the local stack database

## 2. Booking service: read, list, update, delete (`apps/booking`)

- [ ] 2.1 Add `booking-time.util.ts` (zone-less value read as UTC, unparseable value raises 400 `BAD_REQUEST.VALIDATION`) and `booking.mapper.ts` (entity to `BookingDto`, times through `toISOString()`); verify their specs cover an offset, a zone-less value, a week date and the mapped field list
- [ ] 2.2 Add `booking.repository.ts` with `findById`, `findPage` (order `starts_at, id`, `skip = (page - 1) * limit`, optional `roomId`), `update` and `delete`, each with an explicit return type; verify `booking.repository.spec.ts` asserts the query options for page 1, page 2 with limit 5, the room filter, and `null` / `false` for an unknown id
- [ ] 2.3 Add `booking.validator.ts` with the time-order rule (equal and earlier both rejected with 400 `BAD_REQUEST.VALIDATION`); verify its spec covers later, equal and earlier
- [ ] 2.4 Add `booking.service.ts` with `listBookings`, `findBookingById`, `updateBooking` (read, merge stored and changed values, validate, update) and `deleteBooking`, raising 404 `NOT_FOUND.BOOKING` through `ExceptionHelper`; verify `booking.service.spec.ts` covers the found and not-found path of each method, an update that moves `startsAt` past the stored `endsAt`, and an empty change set
- [ ] 2.5 Add `booking.controller.ts` handlers for `BookingPatternEnum.LIST`, `FIND_BY_ID`, `UPDATE` and `DELETE` (one delegating statement each) and `booking.module.ts`; register the module and `NatsClientModule` in the app module; verify the controller spec asserts each pattern's metadata and delegation, and `pnpm nx build booking` passes

## 3. Booking service: idempotent create and confirmation job (`apps/booking`)

Conventions for every task: write the failing spec first, then the code; follow `design.md` for file names and the project rules for style (no `interface`, no `any`, named DTO classes for parameters, explicit repository return types, files under 200 lines). Do not touch `libs/contract`, `apps/room` or `apps/web/src/views/rooms`.

## 1. Shared library (`libs/backend-common`)

- [x] 1.1 Move `isErrorResponse` from `errors/rpc-exception.filter.ts` into an exported `errors/error-response.guard.ts` with its own spec (object with the three fields, missing field, non-object), import it in the filter and export it from `index.ts`; verify `pnpm nx test backend-common` passes with the existing filter spec unchanged
- [x] 1.2 Add `entities/booking.entity.ts` and `entities/idempotency-key.entity.ts` with the columns of design D3, export both from `index.ts` and add them to the `entities` list in `database/data-source.ts`; verify `pnpm nx build backend-common` passes
- [x] 1.3 Add `database/migrations/1731200000002-create-bookings.ts` creating `bookings` (both `CHECK` constraints, both indexes) and `idempotency_keys`, with a `down` that drops them, and register it in `migrations/index.ts`; verify `pnpm run migration:run` then `pnpm run migration:revert` then `pnpm run migration:run` all succeed against the local stack database

## 2. Booking service: read, list, update, delete (`apps/booking`)

- [x] 2.1 Add `booking-time.util.ts` (zone-less value read as UTC, unparseable value raises 400 `BAD_REQUEST.VALIDATION`) and `booking.mapper.ts` (entity to `BookingDto`, times through `toISOString()`); verify their specs cover an offset, a zone-less value, a week date and the mapped field list
- [x] 2.2 Add `booking.repository.ts` with `findById`, `findPage` (order `starts_at, id`, `skip = (page - 1) * limit`, optional `roomId`), `update` and `delete`, each with an explicit return type; verify `booking.repository.spec.ts` asserts the query options for page 1, page 2 with limit 5, the room filter, and `null` / `false` for an unknown id
- [x] 2.3 Add `booking.validator.ts` with the time-order rule (equal and earlier both rejected with 400 `BAD_REQUEST.VALIDATION`); verify its spec covers later, equal and earlier
- [x] 2.4 Add `booking.service.ts` with `listBookings`, `findBookingById`, `updateBooking` (read, merge stored and changed values, validate, update) and `deleteBooking`, raising 404 `NOT_FOUND.BOOKING` through `ExceptionHelper`; verify `booking.service.spec.ts` covers the found and not-found path of each method, an update that moves `startsAt` past the stored `endsAt`, and an empty change set
- [x] 2.5 Add `booking.controller.ts` handlers for `BookingPatternEnum.LIST`, `FIND_BY_ID`, `UPDATE` and `DELETE` (one delegating statement each) and `booking.module.ts`; register the module and `NatsClientModule` in the app module; verify the controller spec asserts each pattern's metadata and delegation, and `pnpm nx build booking` passes

## 3. Booking service: idempotent create and confirmation job (`apps/booking`)

- [x] 3.1 Add `booking-fingerprint.util.ts` (SHA-256 hex over the five fields as sent, fixed order); verify its spec shows equal bodies give equal fingerprints, and a changed title or a differently written instant gives a different one
- [x] 3.2 Add `room-lookup.client.ts` asking `RoomPatternEnum.FIND_BY_ID` through `NatsRequestUtil`, re-raising `NOT_FOUND.ROOM` as a 404 `RpcException` and letting `UNAVAILABLE.SERVICE` pass; verify its spec covers found, unknown room and no answer
- [x] 3.3 Add `confirmation-queue.producer.ts` and register the queue `QueueEnum.BOOKING_CONFIRMATION` in the booking module; verify its spec asserts `add` is called with payload `{ bookingId }`, `jobId` `confirmationJobId(bookingId)`, `attempts` 3 and exponential backoff with delay 1000, and that a rejected `add` is logged and not rethrown
- [x] 3.4 Add `idempotent-booking.repository.ts` with `findByKey` and the single-transaction `create` of design D4 (try advisory lock, read key, insert booking, insert key row), returning the named outcome type; verify its spec, with a mocked `DataSource.transaction` and entity manager, covers the three outcomes and asserts nothing is inserted for *in progress* and *existing*
- [x] 3.5 Add `createBooking` to the service in the order of design D4 (validate, fast-path key read, room lookup, repository create, enqueue only for *created*) and the `BookingPatternEnum.CREATE` handler; verify `booking.service.spec.ts` covers: created (enqueued once, `replayed` false), replay from the fast path and from the repository (`replayed` true, stored body, no room lookup on the fast path, no enqueue), different fingerprint → 422 `UNPROCESSABLE.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, in progress → 409 `CONFLICT.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS`, invalid time order → 400 before any key read, unknown room → 404 with nothing stored

## 4. Booking service: record confirmation (`apps/booking`)

- [x] 4.1 Add `recordConfirmation` to `booking.repository.ts` as one conditional update (`confirmation_status = 'PENDING'` and `confirmation_attempts <= :attempts`); verify the repository spec asserts the where-clause and that zero affected rows resolves without error
- [ ] 4.2 Add `recordConfirmationResult` to the service and the `BookingPatternEnum.RECORD_CONFIRMATION` handler; verify the service and controller specs cover a recorded outcome and an unknown booking id answered without error

## 5. Gateway (`apps/gateway`)

- [ ] 5.1 Add `idempotency-key.guard.ts`; verify its spec covers a missing header, a non-UUID value (both 400 `BAD_REQUEST.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY`) and a valid UUID
- [ ] 5.2 Add `idempotency-replayed.interceptor.ts`; verify its spec shows the body becomes the booking, and the `Idempotency-Replayed: true` header is set only when `replayed` is true
- [ ] 5.3 Add `booking.controller.ts` with the five routes of the `bookings-api` spec and `booking.module.ts`, registered in the app module; verify `booking.controller.spec.ts` (HTTP listener with a mocked NATS client, as in `room.controller.spec.ts`) covers: 201 forwarding `{ idempotencyKey, booking }` to `BookingPatternEnum.CREATE`; replay header; missing key → 400 `BAD_REQUEST.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY` without a NATS call, also when the body is invalid; invalid body → 400 `BAD_REQUEST.VALIDATION`; list defaults, room filter and each invalid query; `GET`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` forwarding with their payload classes; `DELETE` → 204 with an empty body; non-UUID `:id` → 400; an error object from the booking service answered with its status and `errorCode`

## 6. Worker (`apps/worker`)

- [ ] 6.1 Add `simulated-confirmation.sender.ts`; verify its spec is a table over attempts 1 to 3 for an ordinary address, `@retry.example`, `@bounce.example` and an upper-case domain
- [ ] 6.2 Add `booking.client.ts` (find the booking, returning `null` for `NOT_FOUND.BOOKING`; report an outcome) over `NatsRequestUtil`; verify its spec covers found, not found, another error rethrown, and the reported payload
- [ ] 6.3 Add `confirmation.service.ts` implementing the run of design D7; verify its spec covers: ordinary address → reports `SENT`/1 and resolves; retry address attempts 1 and 2 → reports `PENDING` with the attempt and rejects, attempt 3 → `SENT`/3; bounce address attempt 3 → reports `FAILED`/3 and rejects; booking not found → no send, no report, resolves; booking already `SENT` → no send, no report; the same attempt run twice → identical report
- [ ] 6.4 Add `confirmation.processor.ts` on `QueueEnum.BOOKING_CONFIRMATION` (delegates with `bookingId` and `attemptsMade + 1`) and `confirmation.module.ts`; register it and `NatsClientModule` in the app module; verify the processor spec asserts the delegation and `pnpm nx build worker` passes

## 7. Web: services, page and navigation (`apps/web`)

- [ ] 7.1 Add `services/booking.service.ts` (`listBookings`, `createBooking`, `updateBooking`, `deleteBooking`); verify `booking.service.spec.ts`, with `apiClient` mocked, asserts each path and method, that `roomId` is left out when not given, and that create sends the `Idempotency-Key` header
- [ ] 7.2 Add `views/bookings/booking-time-format.ts`; verify its spec covers ISO → `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`, ISO → input value and input value → ISO UTC
- [ ] 7.3 Add `bookings-table.tsx` and `booking-room-filter.tsx`; verify their specs cover the six columns, room name with fallback to the room id, the empty message, the edit and delete actions calling back with the row's booking, and the filter options with "All rooms"
- [ ] 7.4 Add `booking-create-form.tsx` using `react-hook-form` without a resolver; verify its spec covers a valid submit (payload in ISO UTC), a required-field error, the end-after-start error, the disabled button while pending, the API message shown with values kept, the same key reused after a network error, a new key after success and a new key after a field change
- [ ] 7.5 Add `booking-edit-dialog.tsx` and `booking-delete-dialog.tsx`; verify their specs cover prefilled values, save, cancel, the end-after-start error, confirm, decline and the API message shown
- [ ] 7.6 Add `bookings-page.tsx` and `pages/bookings/index.tsx`; verify `bookings-page.spec.tsx`, with `booking.service` and `room.service` mocked, covers loading, rows, empty, load error with the API message, filtering by room (page reset to 1), paging, reload after create, edit and delete, and a delete error
- [ ] 7.7 Add the "Bookings" item to `NAV_ITEMS` in `layouts/app-layout.tsx`; verify `app-layout.spec.tsx` asserts both the "Rooms" and the "Bookings" links

## 8. Integration checks

- [ ] 8.1 Run `pnpm run build`, `pnpm run lint` and `pnpm run test`; verify all three exit 0, and that `git status` shows no change under `libs/contract`, `apps/room` or `apps/web/src/views/rooms`
- [ ] 8.2 Start the stack with `pnpm run stack:up` and walk the `bookings-api` scenarios through the gateway with `curl`; verify create 201, list with and without `roomId`, read, patch, delete 204 then 404, unknown room 404 `NOT_FOUND.ROOM`, and `endsAt` not after `startsAt` 400
- [ ] 8.3 Against the running stack, verify the `booking-idempotency` scenarios: missing and malformed key 400; replay answers the same body with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; a different body answers 422; ten parallel identical requests leave exactly one booking, with every answer being the one plain 201, a replayed 201 or a 409; a key used for a rejected request works afterwards
- [ ] 8.4 Against the running stack, verify the `booking-confirmation` scenarios by reading each booking after its job finished: an ordinary address ends `SENT` with 1 attempt, `@retry.example` ends `SENT` with 3, `@bounce.example` ends `FAILED` with 3, and a booking deleted right after creation leaves no failed job in `tmp/logs/worker.log`
- [ ] 8.5 Open `/bookings` in the web app; verify the navigation link, the table, the room filter, create, edit and delete work against the gateway, then stop the stack with `pnpm run stack:down`

- [x] 6.4 Add `confirmation.processor.ts` on `QueueEnum.BOOKING_CONFIRMATION` (delegates with `bookingId` and `attemptsMade + 1`) and `confirmation.module.ts`; register it and `NatsClientModule` in the app module; verify the processor spec asserts the delegation and `pnpm nx build worker` passes

## 7. Web: services, page and navigation (`apps/web`)

- [x] 7.1 Add `services/booking.service.ts` (`listBookings`, `createBooking`, `updateBooking`, `deleteBooking`); verify `booking.service.spec.ts`, with `apiClient` mocked, asserts each path and method, that `roomId` is left out when not given, and that create sends the `Idempotency-Key` header
- [x] 7.2 Add `views/bookings/booking-time-format.ts`; verify its spec covers ISO → `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm`, ISO → input value and input value → ISO UTC

- [x] 7.5 Add `booking-edit-dialog.tsx` and `booking-delete-dialog.tsx`; verify their specs cover prefilled values, save, cancel, the end-after-start error, confirm, decline and the API message shown
- [x] 7.6 Add `bookings-page.tsx` and `pages/bookings/index.tsx`; verify `bookings-page.spec.tsx`, with `booking.service` and `room.service` mocked, covers loading, rows, empty, load error with the API message, filtering by room (page reset to 1), paging, reload after create, edit and delete, and a delete error
- [x] 7.7 Add the "Bookings" item to `NAV_ITEMS` in `layouts/app-layout.tsx`; verify `app-layout.spec.tsx` asserts both the "Rooms" and the "Bookings" links

- [ ] 8.4 Against the running stack, verify the `booking-confirmation` scenarios by reading each booking after its job finished: an ordinary address ends `SENT` with 1 attempt, `@retry.example` ends `SENT` with 3, `@bounce.example` ends `FAILED` with 3, and a booking deleted right after creation leaves no failed job in `tmp/logs/worker.log`
